actions.title: Change the exposed password for this account
actions.why_it_matters: Credentials leaked in a breach stay useful to attackers for years, because people reuse passwords across services.
steps: Sign in to this account and change the password to one you have not used anywhere else.
Change that same password on every other account that used it.
Turn on two-factor authentication for the account.
Review the account's recent activity and signed-in devices for anything you do not recognise.
